moments.title: Premier League Weekend Action
moments.blurb: The Premier League season continues with a full schedule of matches across Saturday and Sunday, including Newcastle v Bournemouth, Man City v Coventry, Everton v Man Utd and Arsenal v Chelsea.

angles.name: Saturday Showdown
angles.copy: Premier League is BACK with a packed Saturday! Who are you backing for the win today? Newcastle vs Bournemouth, Man City vs Coventry, plus Hull City vs Aston Villa later. Don't miss a kick!

angles.name: Super Sunday Clashes
angles.copy: Super Sunday in the Premier League! Get ready for Everton vs Manchester United and the massive London derby, Arsenal vs Chelsea. What are your score predictions?

moments.title: F1 Italian Grand Prix at Monza
moments.blurb: The Formula 1 Pirelli Gran Premio D'Italia 2026 concludes this weekend at the iconic Monza circuit, with qualifying on Saturday and the main race on Sunday.

angles.name: Monza Race Day
angles.copy: It's race day at Monza! The Italian Grand Prix is set for a thrilling conclusion today. Who will conquer the Temple of Speed?

angles.name: Qualifying Drama
angles.copy: The qualifying drama from Monza was intense! Who snatched pole position for the Italian Grand Prix? All eyes on the grid for tomorrow!

moments.title: Roger Waters turns 83
moments.blurb: Pink Floyd co-founder, bassist, and songwriter Roger Waters celebrates his 83rd birthday on September 6, 2026.

angles.name: Pink Floyd Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Roger Waters! What's your favourite Pink Floyd track he penned?

angles.name: Musical Icon
angles.copy: From 'The Wall' to 'Dark Side of the Moon', Roger Waters' influence is undeniable. Happy 83rd birthday to the musical icon!

moments.title: Macy Gray turns 58
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning soul singer Macy Gray, known for her distinctive voice and hits like 'I Try', celebrates her 58th birthday on September 6, 2026.

angles.name: Soulful Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 58th birthday to the incredible Macy Gray! Her voice is truly one of a kind. What's your go-to Macy track?

angles.name: I Try Love
angles.copy: Remember 'I Try'? It's a classic! Wishing a very happy 58th birthday to the soulful Macy Gray.

moments.title: Paul Waaktaar-Savoy turns 65
moments.blurb: Paul Waaktaar-Savoy, guitarist and principal songwriter for Norwegian synth-pop legends a-ha, celebrates his 65th birthday on September 6, 2026.

angles.name: Take On Me Legend
angles.copy: Happy 65th birthday to Paul Waaktaar-Savoy of a-ha! The man behind some of the 80s' biggest synth-pop anthems. What's your favourite a-ha song?

angles.name: Synth-Pop Mastermind
angles.copy: The songwriting genius of a-ha, Paul Waaktaar-Savoy, is 65 today! Still sounding fresh after all these years.

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing 2026 Launch Show Pre-recording
moments.blurb: The highly anticipated launch show for Strictly Come Dancing 2026, introducing the celebrity-professional pairings, is set to be pre-recorded on Wednesday, September 9th, ahead of its broadcast on September 19th.

angles.name: Strictly Prep
angles.copy: The Glitterball is almost here! Strictly Come Dancing's 2026 launch show is being pre-recorded this Wednesday. Who are you most excited to see hit the dancefloor?

angles.name: New Hosts & Judges
angles.copy: It's a big week for Strictly as the launch show is recorded! With Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe joining the hosting team, it's all change in the ballroom!

moments.title: Joe Perry turns 76
moments.blurb: Aerosmith's legendary lead guitarist and co-songwriter Joe Perry celebrates his 76th birthday on September 10, 2026.

angles.name: Aerosmith Axeman
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the incredible Joe Perry of Aerosmith! What's your favourite guitar riff from the 'Bad Boy from Boston'?

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: From 'Walk This Way' to 'Dream On', Joe Perry has given us so many classics. Happy 76th to a true rock icon!

moments.title: Don Powell turns 76
moments.blurb: Drummer and founding member of glam rock legends Slade, Don Powell, celebrates his 76th birthday on September 10, 2026.

angles.name: Glam Rock Drummer
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to Don Powell, the powerhouse drummer of Slade! What's your favourite Slade anthem?

angles.name: It's Chriiiistmas!
angles.copy: Before it's 'Chriiiistmas!', let's celebrate Don Powell's 76th birthday! The Slade legend helped define 70s glam rock.

moments.title: Siobhan Fahey turns 68
moments.blurb: Singer-songwriter Siobhan Fahey, known for her work with Bananarama and Shakespears Sister, celebrates her 68th birthday on September 10, 2026.

angles.name: Bananarama / Shakespears Sister
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to the iconic Siobhan Fahey! From Bananarama to Shakespears Sister, a true pop trailblazer. What's your favourite track?

angles.name: Stay Cool
angles.copy: She gave us 'Stay' and so much more! Wishing a very happy 68th birthday to the brilliant Siobhan Fahey.

moments.title: F1 Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid
moments.blurb: Formula 1 heads to Spain for the new Madrid Grand Prix circuit, taking place from September 11-13, 2026.

angles.name: New Madrid Circuit
angles.copy: Get ready for the Spanish Grand Prix in Madrid this weekend! A brand new circuit for F1. Who's excited to see how it races?

angles.name: European Leg
angles.copy: F1's European leg continues in Spain this weekend! Will the new Madrid circuit shake up the championship? Tune in!

moments.title: Morten Harket turns 67
moments.blurb: Morten Harket, the charismatic lead singer of Norwegian synth-pop band a-ha, celebrates his 67th birthday on September 14, 2026.

angles.name: a-ha's Voice
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to Morten Harket, the unmistakable voice of a-ha! What's your favourite moment from his career?

angles.name: Pop Icon
angles.copy: He's still taking on the world! Wishing a very happy 67th birthday to synth-pop icon Morten Harket.

moments.title: Nas turns 53
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning rapper and hip-hop legend Nas, known for his influential album 'Illmatic', celebrates his 53rd birthday on September 14, 2026.

angles.name: Hip-Hop Royalty
angles.copy: Happy 53rd birthday to the one and only Nas! An undisputed legend in hip-hop. What's your favourite Nas track or album?

angles.name: Illmatic Legacy
angles.copy: Celebrating 53 years of Nas! The 'Illmatic' creator continues to inspire. Drop your favourite lyric!

moments.title: Huw Bunford turns 59
moments.blurb: Huw Bunford, guitarist for the influential Welsh psychedelic rock band Super Furry Animals, celebrates his 59th birthday on September 15, 2026.

angles.name: Welsh Indie Legend
angles.copy: Penblwydd Hapus to Huw Bunford of Super Furry Animals, turning 59 today! What's your favourite SFA track?

angles.name: SFA Guitarist
angles.copy: The guitar maestro from Super Furry Animals, Huw Bunford, is 59 today! Celebrate with a classic SFA tune!

moments.title: Jaki Graham turns 70
moments.blurb: British R&B and soul singer Jaki Graham, known for 80s hits like 'Could It Be I'm Falling in Love', celebrates her 70th birthday on September 15, 2026.

angles.name: 80s Soul Queen
angles.copy: Happy 70th birthday to the incredible Jaki Graham! Her powerful voice gave us some unforgettable 80s soul. What's your favourite?

angles.name: Falling In Love
angles.copy: Could it be we're celebrating Jaki Graham's 70th birthday? Yes! Send her some love for her special day!
